Container.Name: TravStats
Container.Overview:
Self-hosted flight tracker for small households and groups (1–10 users). Record flights, visualise routes on interactive 2D/3D maps, collect 58 achievements, scan boarding passes (QR/barcode/OCR), import from email and PDF via an optional local Ollama LLM. Includes automated database backups with retention, optional WebDAV off-site sync, and encrypted API-key storage.
**Requirements:**
TravStats needs a PostgreSQL 15 database with the PostGIS extension. Install the [postgis/postgis Community App](https://unraid.net/community/apps?q=postgis) (or any PostGIS 15 container) **before** starting TravStats. Suggested settings:
- Database name: `flights` - Username: `flights` - Password: *(strong — generate with `openssl rand -base64 32`)* - Container name: `travstats-db` (or adjust DATABASE_URL below)
Optional: install the [Ollama Community App](https://unraid.net/community/apps?q=ollama) and pull `gemma3:12b` (~8 GB) for local AI parsing of flight confirmation emails. Point TravStats at it via Admin → Settings → Parser after login (no ENV variable needed).
After first start, open http://[IP]:[PORT:3000]/setup — the first-run wizard captures instance name, public URL, user cap and registration mode. Everything else (API keys, backup schedule, WebDAV, Ollama endpoint + model) is configurable from the admin UI later. No ENV editing needed.
The JWT secret and encryption key are auto-generated on first boot and persisted inside the Application Data mount (`/mnt/user/appdata/travstats/secrets/`) — single volume, survives container updates.
**Full documentation:** https://github.com/Abrechen2/TravStats
Container.DonateText: If TravStats is useful to you

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Host port where TravStats will be accessible.

Config.Name: Application Data
Config.Description: Persistent app data — holds the airport database, user uploads, backups, LLM training artefacts, and the auto-generated JWT secret + encryption key. Single volume; nothing else needs to be mounted.

Config.Name: DATABASE_URL
Config.Description: PostgreSQL connection string. Host is the container name of your PostGIS container; replace CHANGEME with the password you set on that container.
